  CITY COMMISSION AGENDA

  DEFOREST PARK, EDUCATION CENTER, 4:00 PM

Coby Skye, Vice Chair  Rey Gonzales, Commissioner
Donna Bergeron-Birge, Commissioner  Kirk Kunihiro, Commissioner

  SPECIAL MEETING (RETREAT)

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

WELCOME AND INTRODUCTION

1.  24-51882  Recommendation to discuss various topics presented by City Staff for the 2024
  Climate Resilient and Sustainable City Commission Retreat.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Climate Resilient and Sustainable City Commission on non-agenda
items. Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the
Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Alyssa Campos, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 24 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101 or

CALL TO ORDER

At 4:13 PM, Chair Gaytan called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Coffee, Dillon, Gaines, Tolkoff, Wheeler, Skye, Gaytan

Commissioners Absent: Bergeron-Birge, Gonzales, Kunihiro

Also present: Larry Rich, Sustainability Manager, Andre Balanji, Climate Analyst,
Meredith Reynolds, Deputy City Manager, Alyssa Campos, City Clerk Specialist, Kyle Smith, City
Clerk Specialist.

WELCOME AND INTRODUCTION

1.  24-51882  Recommendation to discuss various topics presented by City Staff for the 2024
  Climate Resilient and Sustainable City Commission Retreat.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Coffee, seconded by Commissioner
  Gaines, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  6  Gaytan, Skye, Coffee, Dillon, Gaines, Tolkoff
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 4  Bergeron-Birge, Gonzales, Kunihiro, Wheeler

  Isaac Martinez spoke.

  Larry Rich, Sustainability Manager, City Manager Department, spoke; and provided
  a PowerPoint presentation.
